title: Advanced Ultra Clean Gum Care Toothpaste

details.description:
Parodontax is a daily fluoride toothpaste that is clinically proven to be up to 4x more effective at removing plaque – the main cause of gum problems – than regular toothpaste*. Its advanced formula contains 67% specialised mineral salts, which help physically remove plaque bacteria from the teeth and along the gum line.
Parodontax helps fight gum disease and supports effective oral hygiene by reducing plaque, freshening breath and helping to protect gums for healthier teeth and gums. With a unique taste profile, it leaves your mouth feeling clean and refreshed.
Use Parodontax daily to help prevent gum concerns such as bleeding gums, bad breath, weak or swollen gums, and potential tooth loss associated with advanced gum disease. Strengthen your teeth and enjoy a healthier, more confident smile.
*vs. a regular fluoride toothpaste with twice-daily brushing.

Discover the power of Parodontax, a daily fluoride toothpaste specially formulated to care for both your gums and teeth. With 67% specialised mineral salts, it effectively removes plaque — the root cause of gum problems — leaving your mouth feeling clean and refreshed.
Clinically proven to be 4X more effective at plaque removal than regular toothpaste, Parodontax helps prevent gum issues such as bleeding gums, bad breath, and potential tooth loss. Its unique mineral-rich flavour delivers a fresh brushing experience, while fluoride works to strengthen your teeth for lasting protection.
Ideal for everyday use, Parodontax supports strong, healthy gums, promotes fresher breath, and helps maintain a confident, healthy smile.
Embrace a healthier oral-care routine with Parodontax — your complete solution for daily gum protection and lasting freshness.

Gum problems can be caused by the accumulation of plaque. Parodontax toothbrush is specially designed for people with gum problems. It has soft bristles which are gentle on the gums and effectively remove plaque. Compact head, with a combination of end-rounded inner bristles & double-sided tapered extra soft outer bristles, for effective plaque removal and superior cleaning. Ergonomically shaped handle designed to help provide a secure hold when brushing your teeth.
details.usageInstructions:
It is recommended that toothbrushes are changed every 3 months.
To clean the tongue, rub it with grooves on the brush head and rinse.
